decisions.decision: sim_ground_truth subscribes to Gazebo via gz.transport13 directly, NOT through ros_gz_bridge
decisions.rationale: Live-tested ros_gz_bridge's gz.msgs.Pose_V → tf2_msgs/TFMessage conversion: silently drops pose.name and pose.id, leaving frame_id and child_frame_id empty. Translation data flows but is unidentifiable for per-object filtering. gz.transport13 preserves pose.name (verified live at ~57 Hz).

decisions.decision: Cup drop frames are sibling top-level SDF models (`drop_red`/`drop_green`/`drop_blue`), NOT child links of the cup models
decisions.rationale: Gazebo's Pose_V publishes child-link poses relative to parent model, but top-level models get absolute world poses. Sibling pattern mirrors Isaac Sim's wrapper-Xform-prim trick from isaac-sim-mcp@so-arm101 phase 01.

decisions.decision: aruco_camera_localizer is auto-cloned by bootstrap.sh to /tmp (spaceless path), NOT added as a git submodule of Exploring-VLAs
decisions.rationale: Tried `git submodule add` — hits a known git pack-index bug when the parent repo path contains spaces (this project lives under '~/Documents/Projects/untitled folder/'). Failed with 'fatal: could not open .../tmp_pack_*'. Cloning to /tmp + symlinking into the workspace is the working substitute; same user-facing experience.

decisions.decision: so_arm101_bringup copies camera_publisher from aruco_camera_localizer into its own tree (not a runtime dep)
decisions.rationale: Keeps the lerobot real-hw stack self-contained — same camera frames feed both the lerobot recorder and any aruco-based pose publisher (single source, multiple consumers). Adds CLI flags (--width/--height/--fps/--frame-id) the original lacked, drops aruco-specific exposure/WB clamping for dataset-recording defaults.

decisions.decision: record.sh / record_sim.sh kept as separate-but-aliased — record_sim.sh is now a symlink to record.sh
decisions.rationale: Renamed the wrapper to reflect dual-mode reality (sim+real) without breaking any of the existing docs/PRs/scripts that reference record_sim.sh. Symlink resolves transparently.
